The surface map opened the cell this morning's run missed: a jobs print landing while the long end sits at its 52w floor. The cell is real. TLT long from the NFP close to +3td, gated on TLT within 3% of its 52w low, returns +0.543% against a +0.050% own-drift control, survives declustering (t improves 1.92 to 2.06), is positive in both eras, has all nine leave-one-year-out t-stats positive, improves to +0.926% when the two biggest years are dropped, and clears cost 27 times over with a bootstrap P(mean<=0) of 0.021. It still cannot be traded today. The edge lives entirely in non-midterm years: +0.978% on N=13 with a 92% hit rate, against +0.071% on N=12 with a 58% hit rate in midterms, and 2026 is a midterm year. The same split kills every other expression of the same trade. Today's exact cell, midterm with CPI inside the hold, has occurred once in twenty years, on 2022-05-06 at the most violent point of the hiking cycle. One observation is not a trade. Nothing else on the board survived either: the credit duration divergence that looked striking in the tape has occurred twice in the NFP sample and is unmeasurable rather than merely weak, IWM on the same trigger has negative edge against its own drift, and the utilities complex is now dead in all four of its expressions after the outright, the XLP pair, the SPY spread and the rates channel were each measured separately.
